message:
Thank you, Sarah. I've corrected the language of my original post from "involved in" to "connected (via parent company Reed Elsevier [...]) to."

I'm curious: can you tell me how recent are the changes in intellectual property policy that you reference? More specifically, were those changes made subsequent to [this discussion](http://kairosnews.org/node/4243) five months ago?

I must admit I'm also curious that you chose to respond here -- at a weblog with a very small readership -- rather than to [the post](http://crookedtimber.org/2005/09/09/books-and-bombs/) at the much more widely-read [Crooked Timber](http://crookedtimber.org/).

Thanks for the response.
